title: Selwyn Bicycles Wants You To Pick up Your Trail Bike in the French Alps
content:
John documented the Selwyn Bicycles Trail Bike (€8,850 complete) at this year’s Bespoked London event, and today, the French Alps-based builder has opened up orders…

After three years of building, riding and testing in the French Alps. The Selwyn Bicycles Trail Bike is ready.

Alexander Plaisted has been building custom steel frames since 2016, out of a workshop in Samoëns, Haute-Savoie, in the French Alps. The Trail Bike is the result of three years of engineering, prototyping and testing. It is a full-suspension steel mountain bike designed to ride all day, all over the Alps. To take on multi-day point to point mountain adventures. For long days pedalling, pushing and carrying to access high alpine technical trails. For summer lift laps and winter training missions.

Why This Bike

Selwyn partnered with Dan Roberts of Garage Bike Project to build something unique. Together, they’ve created a unique machine. A frame designed and made by hand in the Alps. Traditional brazing skills combined with modern manufacturing processes. A suspension layout that just works in every situation.

Every bike is collected in person from my workshop in Samoëns, where Alexander will take you out on the trails the bike was designed for. The workshop sits in the woods of the Giffre valley, hidden between Morzine and Chamonix, near the start of the mythical Col de Joux Plane road climb. At the bottom of 1,000 vertical metres of singletrack heaven. The small workshop doesn’t offer delivery. That is the point.

Trail Bike Specs

140 mm of rear travel paired with 160 mm up front via a Horst link layout. 140 mm is the magic number for a true alpine bike, enough to handle the most technical terrain while remaining sharp and efficient under pedaling. 29-inch wheels throughout. No mullet option. No 160/160 version. No 170 fork. Every design decision was taken on the basis of whether or not it improves the way the bike rides, and three years of development says it is spot on as it is.

The frame is built from a specific combination of Reynolds 853, 631, and 931 tubing. Every pivot bolt, axle, spacer, dropout, and brake mount is designed by us. Nothing is off the shelf. The dropouts, chainstay yoke and seat stay pivots are 3D printed in stainless steel. The rocker link and all pivot hardware are machined from 7075 aluminum, anodized and engraved with the Selwyn logo.

Availability and Pricing

The house special build runs a custom-tuned FAST Fenix 2 coil shock, tuned specifically for each rider’s weight before the frame leaves the workshop, alongside a RockShox Lyrik Ultimate fork, Hope wheels, brakes and cockpit, and SRAM Eagle 90 Transmission. Every Hope component is available in your choice of color.

Wet paint is standard in Metallic British Racing Green with yellow logos or Pearl Blue with silver logos. Full custom paint available on request.

The Trail Bike is available to order now at selwynbicycles.co.uk. Full build pricing starts at €8,850. Frame-only pricing is available on request. Every order begins with a conversation.
